prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a rear-end collision. The patient had 24 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1129; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with reported head impact and subsequent concussion symptoms including headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. The mechanism of injury and the force involved are consistent with the reported presentation. Neurological examination and imaging findings clearly confirm the diagnosis of concussion. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known from the patient's history or available records. Care was delivered over 24 visits, consisting of graded symptom management, vestibular and oculomotor exercises, cognitive rest guidance, and progressive return-to-activity planning. Recovery has been slower than typically anticipated for this injury, with symptoms persisting longer than average despite consistent participation in treatment. Billing records reflect single, appropriately itemized charges for each service, with no duplicated entries. Continued follow-up and symptom monitoring are planned.
